message:
So the vulnerability is triggered via the `tls_engine_kpass_sha1` config option. The value is passed to `mosquitto__hex2bin_sha1`, which calls `mosquitto__hex2bin` with `bin_max_len = SHA_DIGEST_LENGTH` (20 bytes). The `tmp` buffer is 20 bytes. If the hex string has more than 20 leading "00" pairs, the loop writes more than 20 zero bytes to `tmp`, causing a stack buffer overflow.

Let me check the fuzz target to understand the exact input format:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mosquitto -name "*fuzz*" -o -name "*broker_fuzz*" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
